1.t: When the heaven is cleft asunder,

3.t: When the seas are poured forth,

5.t: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.

6.t: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,

7.t: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?

8.t: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.

9.t: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.

10.t: Lo! there are above you guardians,

13.t: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.

14.t: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;

15.t: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,

16.t: And will not be absent thence.

17.t: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

18.t: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

19.t: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
